what: The facts behind the sentences of replication/README.md, readme-parts/DETAILS.md, dsweep/README.md and README.md that say when the replication plan and the d-sweep plan were committed, how the d-sweep runs were dispatched and which job checks failed. The commit times are the author dates of the commits that added replication/PLAN.md, dsweep/PLAN.md and the d-sweep code, read with git log --format=%aI in the author's development history, which is not published; this repository's history does not contain these commits, so a reader of it cannot reproduce the times. The public commits and the branch facts were read from this repository with the GitHub API (repos/JacoboPacheco/third-of-a-percent/commits?sha=dsweep-smoke&path=<file>, and .../contents/.github/workflows?ref=<commit>) on 2026-10-17. This file is a record of what was read, not a proof; tests/test_readme_numbers.py compares it with the stored run records.

replication_plan.source: git log of the development history (not published)

dsweep_plan.source: git log of the development history (not published)

dsweep_code.source: git log of the development history (not published)

dsweep_public.source: GitHub API, commits of branch dsweep-smoke per path, read on 2026-10-17

dsweep_branch.source: GitHub API, .github/workflows at that commit, read on 2026-10-17

replication_dispatch.source: GitHub API, contents/replication/PLAN.md?ref=32ab03c returned 404, read on 2026-10-17

replication_combine_runs.failed_step: Per-CPU verdicts, every job of a CPU model pooled (criteria-v3)
replication_combine_runs.source: GitHub API run and job conclusions, and the failing logs of both runs (the FAIL line of harness/pool_check.py), read on 2026-10-17
